skill.name: sandbox-stable
skill.description: Guides development and maintenance for Cloudflare Sandbox applications using the current stable package, matching container image, and stable APIs.
skill.summary: Build and maintain Cloudflare Sandbox applications without mixing stable and preview APIs.
skill.author: cloudflare

content.value_statement: Cloudflare Sandbox projects can fail when stable and preview packages, images, or APIs are mixed. This skill keeps implementation aligned with the stable release.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether the Worker package and container image use the same stable release line.
Guides command execution, streaming, background processes, sessions, and terminal workflows with stable APIs.
Routes file, storage, backup, port, tunnel, proxy, and lifecycle tasks to relevant documentation.
Provides a minimal TypeScript shape for creating a sandbox and running a fixed command.
Guides deprecated API cleanup while keeping the project on the stable package.
Reviews production readiness for package alignment, type checking, secrets, DNS, and deprecated transports.
limitations: It does not support the preview package or preview container image.
It does not perform migrations to the 1.0 preview release.
It relies on current Cloudflare documentation and installed stable types for exact signatures.
It does not deploy infrastructure or execute commands by itself.

use_cases.title: Maintain an Existing Sandbox App
use_cases.description: Update stable Sandbox features while preserving package and container compatibility.

use_cases.title: Review Production Readiness
use_cases.description: Check stable release alignment, secrets handling, network transport, and preview hostname requirements.

use_cases.title: Remove Deprecated Stable APIs
use_cases.description: Find deprecated transports and helpers without starting a preview release migration.

prompt_templates.title: Check Stable Alignment
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this Cloudflare Sandbox project. Confirm whether its package and container image use the stable release, then list any mismatch.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Stable Command Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a stable Sandbox command workflow for this task. Use the installed types and explain whether execution, streaming, or a session fits best.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Stable Production Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this stable Sandbox application for production. Check secrets, RPC transport, wildcard DNS, lifecycle handling, and package-image alignment.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Deprecated Stable APIs
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this repository for deprecated stable Sandbox APIs. Propose replacements, preserve stable behavior, and exclude all preview-only APIs.

output_examples.input: Check whether this existing Sandbox project remains on the stable release.
Choose an API for a long-running command that streams logs.
output_examples.output: Use the stable streaming or background process APIs. Confirm the exact method signature from installed types before implementation.

output_examples.input: Review a stable project before production deployment.
output: Prefer RPC for tunnels and large streams.
Configure wildcard DNS for production preview hostnames.

best_practices: Verify the installed package and container image before writing code.
Use installed stable types and current Cloudflare documentation for exact signatures.
Keep live credentials in the Worker and use outbound handlers for external API calls.
anti_patterns: Do not mix a stable package with a preview container image.
Do not apply preview process handles or terminal APIs to a stable dependency.
Do not place live credentials in the sandbox environment.

faq.question: Does this skill support the preview package?
faq.answer: No. Use the dedicated preview skill for projects using the preview package or image.

faq.question: Can it migrate a stable application to 1.0?
faq.answer: No. Use the migration skill when the user explicitly requests a 1.0 preview migration.

faq.question: Which command API should I use?
faq.answer: Use direct execution for short buffered commands. Use stable streaming or background APIs for long-running work.

faq.question: Can sessions preserve shell state?
faq.answer: Yes. Stable sessions can preserve the working directory and environment across commands.

faq.question: Where should credentials be stored?
faq.answer: Keep live credentials in the Worker. Pass controlled access through outbound handlers when sandbox processes call external services.

faq.question: How should deprecated APIs be handled?
faq.answer: Update the stable package and matching image first. Then follow the deprecation guide without introducing preview-only APIs.
